description: This file defines the AddressMatcher class, a custom matcher for testing that verifies whether a set of PersonAddress objects contains an address matching a specific string value.

classes.name: AddressMatcher
classes.description: A custom matcher extending TypeSafeMatcher to check if a collection of PersonAddress objects contains a specific address.

methods.name: AddressMatcher
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the matcher with the target address string.

methods.name: matchesSafely
methods.description: Checks whether any PersonAddress in the set matches the target address.

methods.name: describeTo
methods.description: Provides a description of the matcher, primarily for error reporting.

methods.name: containsAddress
methods.description: Static factory method to create an AddressMatcher instance for a specific address.
